glm-5-3.description: Recommended — EmpirioLabs' own roster marks this is_featured=true (GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28). Zhipu GLM-5.3: reasoning model with native function calling and web search, response_format json_object structured output, 1M token context, 131,072 token max output — all read directly from the unauthenticated GET https://api.empiriolabs.ai/v1/models. Pricing from the same roster: $1.40 / $4.40 per MTok input/output, $1.40 per MTok cached input. Onboarded credential-free — no live chat, streaming or tool-call request was made, so wire behavior (SSE framing, a real tool_call round-trip, image input) is roster- and docs-verified only, not live-probed; see evidence.liveMatrix (null).

glm-5-3-flash.description: Zhipu GLM-5.3 Flash — lighter/cheaper sibling of the default. The roster marks capabilities.images=true (also video_understanding and document_understanding features), function calling and json_object structured output. 1M context, 131,072 max output. Pricing: $0.075 / $0.25 per MTok input/output, $0.075 cached. Roster-listed only, not capability-probed (credential-free onboarding — no live request made); fallback.

glm-5-2.description: Zhipu GLM-5.2 — prior GLM generation; reasoning, function calling, web search; json_object structured output; 1M context, 131,072 max output. Pricing $1.40 / $4.40 per MTok. Roster-listed only, not capability-probed; fallback.

kimi-k3.description: Moonshot Kimi K3 — reasoning, function calling, multimodal (capabilities.images=true on the roster), agentic coding and web search; strict json_schema structured output (a stronger guarantee than glm-5-3's json_object). 1M context, 131,072 max output. Pricing $3 / $15 per MTok. Roster-listed only, not capability-probed; fallback.

qwen3-7-max.description: Alibaba Qwen3.7 Max — flagship text reasoning model with code_interpreter, function calling and agentic coding; strict json_schema structured output. 1M context, 65,536 max output (lower than the GLM family's 131,072 — read from the roster, not assumed). Pricing $2.50 / $7.50 per MTok. Roster-listed only, not capability-probed; fallback.

minimax-m2-7-highspeed.description: MiniMax M2.7 Highspeed — reasoning and function calling only (no vision or web_search declared on the roster); json_object structured output. Smallest context in this curated set (200K, 32,768 max output) — kept as the lightest/cheapest fallback. Pricing $0.30 / $1.20 per MTok, $0.03 cached. Roster-listed only, not capability-probed; fallback.

errorRules.message: Invalid EmpirioLabs API key. Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Get one at {setupUrl}

instructions: 1. Visit: https://platform.empiriolabs.ai and create an account
2. Create an API key from the dashboard (keys use the sk-empiriolabs- prefix, up to 50 per account)
3. Selected models (e.g. GLM 4.7 Flash) run at $0 cost; other models draw from prepaid credits topped up via the dashboard Billing page — confirm current pricing before heavy use
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.empiriolabs.ai/v1 (docs.empiriolabs.ai confirms it accepts the OpenAI Chat Completions request format). Hosts a large catalog — 217 models on an unauthenticated GET /v1/models as of 2026-09-28 — spanning text, vision, audio, video, image and 3D generation; this catalog entry covers only a curated set of text/chat-completions-capable models. New accounts default to 50 RPM / 2,000,000 TPM.
